task.description:
Validate SCH-05 release readiness.

1. Read docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md to confirm all SCH-05 acceptance criteria
2. Read tests/reports/WF02-sch05-20260523-run-01.md to confirm tests pass
3. Run zig build (must exit 0)
4. Run zig build test (must exit 0)
5. Check that all 4 acceptance criteria from SCH-05 are verified by passing tests
6. Write the release decision to docs/status/release-sch05-20260523.json

SCH-05 acceptance criteria:
- GIVEN the platform was offline when one or more timers became due, WHEN the platform restarts and SCH-02 begins polling, THEN it fires all timers with status=PENDING and fire_at≤NOW() as overdue
- Overdue timer events MUST include fired_late:true and actual firing timestamp vs scheduled fire_at
- No overdue timer MUST be skipped; all are fired exactly once
- The first SCH-02 poll after restart fires ALL overdue timers in sequence

If PASS, set requirement_status.json SCH-05 to status=TESTED.
If FAIL, list which criteria are unmet in result.issues.
acceptance_criteria: All SCH-05 acceptance criteria verified by passing tests

result.summary: SCH-05 release APPROVED. zig build (exit 0), zig build test (exit 0), all 11 unit tests PASS, all 4 acceptance criteria verified by passing tests. Release decision written to docs/status/release-sch05-20260523.json.
result.next_action: Route to DOC-UPDATER to set SCH-05 requirement status RELEASED
